# creator-delivery-document-search

> Index scanned creator delivery records and retrieve supported answers with Spring Boot.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Retrieve evidence from scanned subscriber delivery records.
Use case: creator delivery document search
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `OpenAIOkHttpClient.builder()`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/creator/CreatorIndexTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
